summary: BBB Foods Inc. filed a 6-K announcing the pricing of a follow-on public offering of 13,304,174 Class A common shares at $32.50 per share, composed of 700,000 primary shares (raising ~$22.75M for the company) and 12,604,174 secondary shares (raising ~$409.64M for selling shareholders). The offering is made under an automatic shelf registration on Form F-3 and is expected to close June 1, 2026. Underwriters have a 30-day option to purchase up to 1,995,626 additional shares from the company. J.P. Morgan and Morgan Stanley are global coordinators, with BTG Pactual, Santander, and Scotiabank as joint bookrunners. This is an ordinary-capital-markets transaction, not a special situation.
